exposure: listeriosis diagnosis in pregnant women (obstetric listeriosis)
cohort: All hospitalizations with a listeriosis diagnosis in pregnant women and/or newborns in Spain from 2000 to 2021, identified using the National Registry of Hospital Discharges.
finding: The incidence of obstetric and neonatal listeriosis in Spain significantly increased from 2000 to 2021, with pregnancy-related listeriosis having a deleterious impact on fetal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Pregnancy-related listeriosis was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section (OR=1.68).
